_comment: Same-machine variant of multisession.json for a machine whose ROM collection holds only shinobi: three independent shinobi sessions. Every machine-specific fact is the shinobi one from multisession.json / shinobi.json. Checks that need two different machines are reported by the harness as NOT EXERCISED, never as passed.

extra_start.note: started after one session was stopped and a start failed, to show the slot is reusable

missing_rom_system.note: a system MAME knows whose ROM set is in none of the harness ROM paths (checked in preflight); the harness gives the server an empty pacman folder, so MAME itself fails the start for missing files. No ROM data is created, downloaded or modified.

capture.note: 68000 level-4 autovector handler, hit about every frame (shinobi.json maincpu.handler_pc)

ram.note: plain RAM in the declared map (shinobi.json checkpoint_input.ram)

rom_read.note: 68000 vector table: initial SP and PC
